patchRules.senseRevision: create the next immutable parent Sense revision for every Sense with at least one planned nested lifecycle transition
patchRules.children: status-only DRAFT/IN_REVIEW -> APPROVED; preserve child IDs, owners, languages, text, order, preferred flags, and existing provenance references
patchRules.lexemes: reuse existing APPROVED Lexeme pins; no Lexeme revision unless a dependency requires one (none found)
patchRules.classifications: reuse all existing APPROVED Classification pins unchanged; no CEFR change
patchRules.taxonomy: reuse the existing APPROVED 2.0.1 snapshot unchanged
patchRules.provenance: reuse all 799 existing Provenance pins; allocate none
patchRules.media: reuse none; source release contains no media

expectedManifestChanges: Sense revision pins and corresponding content hashes
